selected_problem: After delivery postvalidation rechecks were added, fresh-main inspection exposed a remaining time-of-check/time-of-use gap: NorthStarRunner.delivery checked the validated postimage before git_commit authorization, while gitLocalCommit later staged the current working-tree bytes. A path could therefore change after the delivery check but before git add, allowing unvalidated bytes to enter the Git index and commit.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: Fresh main reduced the next evidence-rich central bottleneck to a narrow delivery-index binding gap. The committed four-mode router's singular-bottleneck gate routes the replay to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT; no forced rotation was used.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt or fabricated numeric DWAC score is claimed.

pre_fix_reproduction.source_observation: NorthStarRunner.delivery called checkDeliveryPostimage before git_commit authorization, while gitLocalCommit later performed git add from the then-current workspace and committed that index without comparing the staged bytes to the validation receipt.
pre_fix_reproduction.consequence: A content or executable-mode edit occurring between the delivery check and git add could be committed without having passed the recorded validation.

changes: gitLocalCommit can now receive the validated postimage receipt and, after git add, re-read the Git index blobs and tracked executable mode for every run-owned path.
The staged Git index must match validation-time existence, SHA-256 content, and Git-representable executable mode before git commit is allowed.

If the staged index diverges, delivery fails closed with GIT_INDEX_POSTIMAGE_DRIFT, selected paths are unstaged, no commit is created, and NorthStarRunner moves the run to REPAIR_REQUIRED with auditable evidence.
The original pre-authorization delivery postimage check remains in place, while the new index binding closes the later staging race without pretending the working tree itself is immutable.

validation.tests: 3/3 focused Git delivery regressions PASS on the Linux verification host

truth_boundaries: This binds the Git index commit artifact to the validation receipt for run-owned files; it does not make the working tree immutable after staging, and unrelated workspace files may still change.

Git records regular-file executability rather than full POSIX mode bits, so the index comparison intentionally verifies content plus Git-representable executable mode; full filesystem metadata remains governed by the workspace transaction layer.
OS-level validation sandboxing, arbitrary complex semantic synthesis, Windows descendant-tree equivalence, and crash-level filesystem atomicity remain unresolved.
No GitHub Actions are intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push is used, and no credential, payment, formal Release, or destructive/irreversible external action is performed.
